trackSubtitle: Log aktivitas manual gratis — berjalan, berlari, bersepeda, mendaki. Premium menambahkan GPS dan statistik lanjutan (gaya MapMy, Super Bundle).
trackSubtitleBrief: Log a walk or run. GPS and extras when you want them.
trackLogDesc: Tidak diperlukan GPS — entri manual berfungsi offline di mana saja.
trackNotesPlaceholder: Lingkaran taman pagi, terasa luar biasa
trackPremiumDesc: Pelacakan gaya MapMy, rute, grafik kecepatan, pelatihan lintas pilar.
trackGpsPremiumDesc: Rekam jalan-jalan dan lari di luar ruangan dengan jarak langsung — gaya MapMy, Super Bundle.
trackGpsUnsupported: GPS tidak didukung pada perangkat ini.
trackGpsTooShort: Perlu lebih banyak titik GPS — berjalanlah lebih lama.
trackGpsIdle: Mulailah saat Anda mulai berjalan atau berlari.
trendAskLead: Ask in your own words — "protein this week", "volume over 30 days". Answered on this device, offline.
trendAskNoMetric: This app does not measure that — no wearable, no guessing.
trendAskShort: Not enough logged in that window to draw a trend. Log a few more and ask again.
trackGpsHint: Izinkan lokasi saat diminta. Berfungsi paling baik di luar ruangan dengan langit cerah.
trackGpsPreviewChart: Grafik kecepatan langsung saat Anda bergerak
trackGpsLockedHint: Tingkat gratis menyimpan pencatatan manual dan impor JSON. Premium membuka kunci GPS + statistik kecepatan mingguan.
trackWeeklyGpsLocked: Jarak GPS mingguan dan kecepatan rata-rata — Super Bundle.
bodyMetricsLead: Weight and measures on this device. Included in JSON backup.
bodyMetricsNeedTwo: Log at least two entries to see a trend.
progressPhotosLead: Stored in browser IndexedDB only — not uploaded, not in JSON backup.
progressPhotosDrop: Drop or tap to add a photo
trackImportEmpty: No activities found in this file.
trackImportDesc: Import from Apple Health Shortcuts JSON, Google Fit / Takeout export, or CSV (date,type,durationMin,distanceKm). Free — no live wearable account required.
trackImportDropIdle: Drop JSON/CSV files or click to browse
trackImportNeedJsonCsv: Use JSON or CSV activity exports.
trackImportHowTo: Apple: Shortcuts → Find Workouts → Get Details → Save File as JSON with date, type, durationMin. Google: export Fit activities (or Takeout) and convert to the same fields, or use CSV.
